# Return... Meditation Timer by 941 Apps

> A meditation timer with nothing in the way: one tap, a room to sit in, a bell when it is time. No guided voices, no account, no subscription. For iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac, and Apple TV.

For comprehensive information, see: [llms-full.txt](https://941return.com/llms-full.txt)

## About

Return... (the store name is "Return... Meditation Timer") is a deliberately minimal meditation timer for people who already know how to sit. You choose a length, a room and a bell, and the app gets out of the way. There are five rooms: Water, Fire, Forest, Silence, and Music. The Music room plays Still Rooms, an original album of ten pieces written and recorded for the app by Dream of Electric; every piece is a 5.1 mix, so on AirPods with Spatial Audio the music sits around the listener, and on Apple Watch it plays through paired headphones. One purchase, $9.99, no subscription.

## Key Features

- 5 to 60 minutes; three bells (Singing Bowl, Temple Bell, Soft Chime) rung once, twice or three times
- Repeat once, a set number of times, until a time of day, or until you stop
- Five rooms with a background sound for each, or none
- Still Rooms: ten pieces in order while you sit, Spatial Audio on AirPods
- Mindful Minutes logged to Apple Health; settings and session history across devices through iCloud
- Widget and Live Activity for the sit in progress
- Choice of app icon: the album's glass cube, the water drop, fire or forest
- Made for iPhone Duo: one immersive canvas, two compositions (closed and open), the fold confines the pieces rather than adding a layout
- 27 languages, including Arabic and Hebrew with mirrored layouts
- No account, no ads, nothing sold; anonymous crash reports and usage counts that can be switched off in Settings

## App Details

- Platforms: iOS, iPadOS, watchOS, macOS, tvOS (iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac, Apple TV)
- Current version: 1.2.0 (October 2026)
- Price: $9.99, one purchase
- Developer: 941 Apps (Blake Crosley)
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/return/id6756242021
- Website: https://941return.com

## Still Rooms (album)

Still Rooms, by Dream of Electric. Tracks: Paper Boat, Morning Glass, Low Tide, Cloud Copy, Snow Street, Night Train, Blue Hour, Afternoon Shade, Rain Window, Returning. A thirty-second stereo clip of Paper Boat is on the home page.
